details:
- CVE-2022-32547: EXIF: read SINGLE/DOUBLE values without misaligned float/double loads
- CVE-2018-16329: property: use a default ImageInfo when InterpretImageProperties() gets NULL to avoid a NULL dereference
- CVE-2022-32546: PCL: clamp the render geometry when converting double to integer
- CVE-2020-27766: evaluate: implement left/right shift by repeated multiply/divide to avoid an out-of-range shift
- CVE-2021-20309: wave: avoid division by zero on a zero wave length
- CVE-2021-20311: colorspace: avoid division by zero on a zero film-gamma in log transforms
- CVE-2025-53019: stream: do not leak the QuantumInfo when StreamImage() is entered more than once
- CVE-2026-25798: pixel cache: check the size for overflow and reset the cache state when opening it fails
- CVE-2026-56361: morphology: reject a user kernel origin equal to the kernel width/height
- CVE-2025-68618: MSL/SVG: limit element nesting depth to prevent stack exhaustion
- CVE-2025-69204: SVG writer: use size_t and overflow checks for the path point count
- CVE-2026-56379: SVG: escape attribute and style values written to the internal MVG
- CVE-2026-109262: SVG writer: free token and primitive_info on unbalanced pop
- CVE-2026-46523: MSL: disable blob support to avoid a use-after-free
- CVE-2026-86421: MSL: release the per-level DrawInfo when an image level is popped
- CVE-2026-25796: STEGANO: free the watermark image on early exits
- CVE-2026-106579: enforce the coder policy on the decoder/encoder actually invoked
- CVE-2026-25965: policy: also match the canonical path against path-domain rules
- CVE-2025-55154: MNG: compute the magnified width/height in size_t to avoid an integer overflow
- CVE-2026-45664: MNG: cap the number of LOOP/ENDL operations to stop excessive resource use
- CVE-2026-109260: PNG: release the cloned image and image_info when libpng initialisation fails
- CVE-2025-43965: MIFF: refresh the image depth after SetQuantumFormat()
- CVE-2026-46522: MIFF: reject zero-length, oversized and short compressed chunks instead of looping forever
- CVE-2026-61869: MIFF: release quantum_info when an allocation fails in the encoder
- CVE-2026-106565: blob: set end-of-file on a short bzip2 read to avoid an infinite loop
- CVE-2026-106568: XML: check parameter entities for circular references to avoid an infinite loop
- CVE-2026-33900: VIFF: refuse a raster size that does not fit in size_t
- CVE-2026-61870: VIFF: release the pixel buffer when the colormap allocation fails
- CVE-2026-61863: TIFF: destroy the Group4 huffman image when the temporary file cannot be created
- CVE-2026-26066: IPTCTEXT: read the next byte before restarting the loop to avoid an infinite loop
- CVE-2026-25799: YUV: reject an invalid sampling factor so it cannot cause a division by zero
- CVE-2026-61868: YUV: free the scanline and chroma image when opening a partition file fails
- CVE-2026-109263: YUV: release yuv_image and chroma_image on writer error paths
- CVE-2025-57803: BMP: check the scanline stride for overflow when reading and writing
- CVE-2025-62171: BMP: reject a columns*bits_per_pixel overflow
- CVE-2019-7398: DIB: free the pixel buffer when the colormap allocation fails
- CVE-2019-7175: PCD: free the Huffman tables on DecodeImage error paths
- CVE-2026-56378: PCD: stop decoding when the write pointer reaches the end of the plane
- CVE-2019-7397: PDF: free the xref table on WritePDFImage error returns
- CVE-2026-106567: PSD: reject invalid resource block sizes so 32-bit builds cannot loop forever
- CVE-2026-109964: PICT: stop when the row pointer wraps below the pixel buffer
- CVE-2026-56368: BGR/CMYK/RGB/YCbCr: free quantum_info when opening an output file fails
